season_context.local_season_notes: The SS27 shows in New York, London, Milan and Paris ran through September and early October 2026, and Première Vision Paris in September previewed AW27/28 materials. Retail is in AW26 and holiday trading now. SS27 product reaches stores from early 2027, and Ramadan around February 2027 matters for Muslim-majority and diaspora markets.

sources.title: Paris Fashion Week SS27 trends (The Zoe Report)

trends.name: Luminous Blue, colour of 2027
trends.summary: WGSN and Coloro picked Luminous Blue as 2027's colour of the year, a bright, slightly eccentric blue they consider versatile enough for occasionwear and activewear.

trends.name: WGSN SS27 key colours
trends.summary: Alongside Luminous Blue, WGSN's SS27 palette features Energy Orange, playful Pop Pink, calming Meadowland Green and Clay, a warm pinkish earth neutral.

trends.name: Pantone NYFW SS27 palette
trends.summary: Pantone's NYFW SS27 report pairs loud shades like Dragon Fire orange, Chili Pepper and Hibiscus with pale Anise Flower, Rosy Future and herbal Lavender Oil, plus five seasonless neutrals.

trends.name: Citrus orange takeover
trends.summary: Orange led both Paris and London SS27. Hermès, Chanel, Loewe and Mugler used citrus shades, while Mulberry and others ranged from tangerine to ginger.

trends.name: Butter yellow and poppy red
trends.summary: New York SS27 used pale butter yellow to brighten neutrals (Proenza Schouler, Tibi, TWP) and warm poppy red as a polished hit of colour (Altuzarra, Carolina Herrera).

trends.name: Sugared pastels
trends.summary: Milan moved from autumn's strong tones to candy-like peach, mint and lemon. Paris and London added butter, lavender, sage and baby pink.

trends.name: AW27/28 russet, lilac, maize, deep green
trends.summary: WGSN and Coloro's AW27/28 colours are warm Russet, soft Peaceful Lilac, optimistic Maize yellow and Deep Green, which they suggest as an alternative to black.

trends.name: AW27/28 plum and reversible wool
trends.summary: Première Vision's AW27/28 direction favours violet, plum and deep red over black, evening satins and crushed velvet, reversible double-face woollens and fine, thermoregulating wool.

trends.name: Archive checks and stripes
trends.summary: Milan SS27 used retro checks, stripes and vintage-style graphics at Prada, Marni, MM6, MSGM and Gucci, often clashing colourways on purpose.

trends.name: Slogans and poster graphics
trends.summary: Paris SS27 printed bold slogans, vintage poster art and colourful patterns on tees, jackets and caps at Dries Van Noten, Celine, Sacai, Marine Serre and Valentino.

trends.name: Head-to-toe bold stripes
trends.summary: New York SS27 showed loud, full-rainbow and all-over stripes at Diane von Furstenberg, Proenza Schouler and Tommy Hilfiger.

trends.name: The skirt as staple
trends.summary: Skirts dominated SS27 in every city: knee-length at Prada and Ferragamo, Chanel's just-below-knee length, and sheer or jewelled versions worn as everyday basics.

trends.name: Modern goddess drape
trends.summary: London SS27 revisited classical Greek dressing with draped fabric, loose shapes, trailing ribbons and billowing volume, notably at Pauline Dujancourt.

trends.name: Bubble and pouf skirts
trends.summary: Loewe and Dior put puffed bubble skirts at the centre of SS27. Miu Miu and Zimmermann cut them very short, and Comme des Garçons did one in denim.

trends.name: Peplum revival
trends.summary: New York presented the peplum as SS27's defining shape, gathered, ruffled or crinoline-like at the hip, at Proenza Schouler, Khaite, Diotima and Ashlyn.

trends.name: Close-cut cinched tailoring
trends.summary: Oversized blazers faded in Milan. Armani, Gucci and Jil Sander cut jackets close to the body and cinched at the waist.

trends.name: Statement waist belts
trends.summary: Waists are emphasised with stacked or obi-style belts in Milan and wide cummerbunds over tailoring in New York, giving relaxed looks more structure.

trends.name: Sheer layers and glossy plastics
trends.summary: Milan SS27 mixed transparency and shine: latex-effect rubber and PVC at Ferragamo, organza at Moschino and Sportmax, sheer knits at Fendi and veils at Jil Sander.

trends.name: Airy gingham, tulle and mesh
trends.summary: Première Vision's SS27 mills offered cloqué gingham, honeycomb knits, stretch tulle, sporty mesh, fine lace, pearly sequins and 3D arabesques on tulle.

trends.name: Embellished, delicate denim
trends.summary: Milan softened jeans with lace and floral embroidery. Dolce & Gabbana set red lace into seams, and Ermanno Scervino and Genny added floral motifs.

trends.name: Coated and spray-painted denim
trends.summary: New York SS27 denim moved beyond classic blue with coated finishes, spray-painted surfaces and candy-coloured dyes at Area, 7 For All Mankind, Simkhai and PatBo.

trends.name: Lacquered and varnished finishes
trends.summary: Première Vision's SS27 materials included varnished and lacquered surfaces in dense, saturated colour, alongside maximalist abstract and floral prints.

trends.name: Bloomers and ballet flats
trends.summary: Lyst's Q3 2026 hottest products included Free People bloomer pants, Chanel ballet flats and a Dries Van Noten scarf-skirt, mixing quiet luxury with playful dressing.

trends.name: Retro sneakers return
trends.summary: Lyst's Q3 2026 ranking featured the Celine x Reebok Freestyle Lo and the Vans Premium Authentic, signalling nostalgic, low-profile sneakers over chunky styles.

trends.name: Prada back on top; slouchy bags
trends.summary: Prada topped Lyst's Q3 2026 brand ranking for the first time since 2023, and its Wish pouch was the top product. Slouchy top-handle bags from COS to Balenciaga also ranked.

trends.name: Everyday opulence
trends.summary: Milan SS27 brought couture-like occasion pieces into daywear, styling them with plain staples at Alberta Ferretti, Elisabetta Franchi and Armani.

trends.name: Modest fashion week in Paris
trends.summary: Paris hosted its first Modest Fashion Week in April 2026, with fully covering silhouettes and tailored headscarf styling, a sign that modest dressing is reaching mainstream calendars.

trends.name: Fibre-to-fibre recycling and biomaterials
trends.summary: The industry is shifting from bottle-based recycled polyester to textile-to-textile recycling, closed-loop lyocell and viscose, and mycelium or plant-based leathers. Cost and scale are still limits.

trends.name: AI search, smart eyewear, resale
trends.summary: State of Fashion 2026 ranks AI as the top opportunity and expects smart-glasses sales to quadruple in 2026. Resale is set to grow two to three times faster than new sales.

trends.name: Lingerie as a visible layer
trends.summary: Bras worn over shirts, under jackets or built into skirt sets appeared at Prada, Fendi, Marni and Tod's for SS27, while New York showed undone, déshabillé layering.
